objective: Materialize the missing machine-checked layer between existing content-addressed receipts and the independently verified finite-trace forward-simulation theorem. Compile exact state-conditioned local-refinement residuals without treating benchmark or matched-score parity as semantic refinement.

semantic_contract.row: Each transition row binds a precondition, target transition class, Brain macrostep contract, postcondition, evaluator-aware relation, scope/authority, cross-state carry, ownership, and a content-addressed local-refinement proof.
semantic_contract.global: Whole-trace candidate readiness additionally requires content-addressed trace-scope, initialization, constructor-preservation, terminal-preservation, and acceptance-order-soundness receipts.
semantic_contract.hidden_unrestricted_rule: UNRESTRICTED_HIDDEN requires a content-addressed observational-equivalence receipt; absence or weaker evidence fails closed.
semantic_contract.forbidden_shortcut: BENCHMARK_SCORE MATCHED_SCORE AGGREGATE_PARITY POINT_ESTIMATE ASSERTION_ONLY may not satisfy LOCAL_REFINEMENT.
semantic_contract.content_address_rule: Every receipt path must resolve under the repository root and its actual Git blob SHA-1 is recomputed from bytes; claimed SHA text alone never counts.
semantic_contract.semantic_binding_rule: Every row requires a separately content-addressed contract-binding JSON whose relation id, precondition, target transition, Brain macrostep, postcondition, evaluator binding, and evidence receipt references exactly match the compiled row.
semantic_contract.global_binding_rule: Whole-trace readiness requires a separately content-addressed global binding that exactly binds the target claim, relation id, and all global theorem receipts.

tests: complete row plus global receipts reaches candidate-ready with zero credit
missing local refinement receipt remains open
benchmark score cannot substitute for local refinement
unrestricted hidden evaluator requires observational equivalence
restricted hidden evaluator requires utility-class and material-order receipts
missing constructor preservation blocks whole-trace readiness
invalid content address does not close a row
forged or mismatched claimed Git blob SHA fails closed against recomputed repository bytes
row contract binding mismatch fails closed
global contract binding mismatch fails closed
Git blob SHA preimage uses the required NUL separator and actual bytes
